practice.raak_alle_vijf_dubbels_op_het_o: Hit all five doubles on the practice board to complete the challenge.
practice.oefen_op_je_eigen_tempo_en_spee: Practise at your own pace and unlock badges. Your DP stays the same.
practice.label: {progress} / {total}
practice.oefenbord: Practice board{hasTarget, select, true {, target {target}} other {}}
practice.alle_vijf_dubbels_geraakt_lekke: All five doubles hit. Well thrown!
practice.de_rode_bull_telt_50_groen_erom: The red BULL scores 50. The green ring scores 25.
practice.drie_pijlen_per_beurt_alle_ruim: Three darts per visit. All the room you need to practise.
practice.nieuwe_poging_begint_weer_op_je: A new attempt starts at your chosen checkout.
practice.geen_finish_mogelijk_met_de_res: No checkout possible with the remaining darts.
practice.oefenen_verandert_je_dp_niet: Practice does not change your DP.
practice.vijf_pijlen_helemaal_op_je_eige: Five darts, entirely at your own pace.
practice.copy_de_groene_indicator_beweeg: The green indicator moves automatically. Stop it where you want to aim horizontally. Then choose the height.
practice.copy_de_verticale_balk_werkt_he: The vertical bar works the same way: the top means high on the board, the bottom means low. The dart flies as soon as you stop the second indicator.
practice.copy_probeer_nu_het_midden_te_v: Try to find the centre now. The small red bull is worth 50 points; the surrounding green ring 25.
practice.copy_mik_voor_de_bull_op_het_mi: For the BULL, aim for the centre of both bars.
practice.copy_de_buitenste_smalle_ring_v: The narrow outer ring doubles the value. The narrow inner ring is a treble and counts three times.
practice.copy_d20_is_40_punten_t20_is_60: D20 is 40 points. T20 is 60 points.
practice.copy_je_kent_de_bediening_pak_j: You know the controls. Find your own rhythm and choose a segment. In a 501 match, finish on a double or BULL.
practice.copy_je_score_verandert_pas_wan: Your score changes only when the tip hits the board.
